meta.name: caveman-review
meta.description: Compressed code review - one line per finding with location, problem and fix. Use for /caveman-review, "review this PR", or "review the diff".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把代码审查压缩成逐条问题清单
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常要快速review合并请求。
copy.tagline_en: Review code changes with one-line findings per issue.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently review pull requests and want compressed feedback.

howto.what: 代码审查时，Claude逐条输出意见，每行格式为“行号:问题。修复建议。”，并可选加🔴bug/🟡risk/🔵nit/❓q前缀。不做寒暄、不复述代码意图、不写修复代码或运行linter。涉及安全、架构分歧或新人场景时改用正常段落解释。
howto.when: 当你说出“/caveman-review”、“review this PR”、“review the diff”等指令，或要求审查某个PR/差异时触发。当你说“stop caveman-review”或“normal mode”时恢复常态。

say.note: 对本PR按压缩格式进行审查。
每条意见按行号+问题+修复输出。
退出压缩模式，恢复平常的详细审查。

howto.what_en: During code review Claude gives terse findings: one line each with location, problem, fix, optional severity prefix (bug/risk/nit/q). No filler or restating code; doesn't write fixes, approve, or run linters. Uses plain paragraphs for security, architecture, onboarding.
howto.when_en: Triggered by the command /caveman-review or phrases like "review this PR" / "review the diff". "stop caveman-review" or "normal mode" reverts to verbose style.

say_en.note: Enters compressed review for this PR.
Each finding on one line with location, problem, fix.
Reverts to the normal verbose style.
